Apphcation ae invited for one Guost faculy (Asslstant Prolossor) In the Centre for Systerns Biology &

basis, for the acadormic session 2023-24
Essential Qualification for the post of Asslstant Profossor
1 Good academic record as define by the concemed University with at least 55% of the marks (50% in
case of SC/ST/Physically &Visually handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point wherever grading
system is followed at Master's degree level i.e. Masters in Computer Science from an Indian
University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University
2. Besides fulfiling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test
(NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR.
3. The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations,
2009. shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Desirable
Ph.D. degree in Computer Science with at least two-years of research experience or teaching
experience of post-graduate classes in the field of respective subject with relevant publication/s in
peer reviewed journals.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1000/- per lecture with an upper
limit of Rs. 25,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to undertake that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and will do the same till they are teaching in
Centre for Systems Biology & Bioinformatics as a Guest Faculty.
Applications should reach via email on 14.03.2023 at csbb2007@pu.ac.in & csbboffice@gmail.com
Interview wll be held on 15.03.2023 at 10:00 a.m in the Office of the Chairperson, Centre for System
Biology & Bioinformatics, South Campus Sector-25, Panjab University Chandigarh. No TA/DA will be
paid for attending the interview.
